policy.coverage: Use fixed quotas A6, B4, C5, D6, E4, F3, G2 and prefer distinct topic coverage within each group.
policy.priority: Prefer usable OA canine evidence, then stronger evidence grade, complete grading inputs, and publication recency. Replace structured-query topic mismatches with the next relevant record. Because topic relevance cannot be resolved reliably from title/MeSH alone, the exact identifier list requires owner review and becomes immutable after approval.
